artifactBuildDeltaFromFreeze: documentation-only (README / MMS discovery docs); no ARStack Studio, embedded firmware, supervisor, or realtime publisher source delta

exceptions.risk: The 250 us sample clock starts before synchronous profile logging completes, causing deterministic missed slots at every START; asynchronous telemetry buckets are also mislabeled as one-second fps windows.
exceptions.rationale: Physical board evidence showed the first stream counter starting after skipped slots and fail-closed RC2 telemetry outside 3999..4001 despite a stable 3999.94 fps wire segment. The minimum production fix moves timer enable after preparation and reports elapsed-time-normalized fps from a bounded lock-free tick counter.
exceptions.verification: ESP32-P4 build and realtime boundary policy gate; real-board 10x Start/Stop; first transmitted smpCnt begins at 0 with missed=0; retained 4000-fps telemetry has missed=0 and TX fail=0; independent capture proves continuous counters and 3999..4001 fps; full exact-head release gates.

exceptions.risk: The timer/log ordering and normalized telemetry invariant could regress without a deterministic source-policy gate.
exceptions.rationale: Add the smallest CI assertion at the existing ESP32-P4 firmware boundary instead of introducing a second test framework or weakening the physical evaluator.
exceptions.verification: The workflow must reject timer enable before START-path formatting, missing lock-free sample tick accounting, or removal of elapsed-time telemetry normalization; the complete ESP32-P4 firmware build must still pass.
